metadata.policy: Public, lawful OSINT only: feeds already published for public viewing (port-authority webcam pages, Windy and other webcam aggregators, public YouTube livestreams, tourism/marina cams, public traffic cameras). No private CCTV, no default-credential or exposed-RTSP scanning, no bypassing logins, geofencing, paywalls or robots.txt, no scraping where terms forbid it. Every feed records its source URL and terms.
metadata.verification: A feed is 'verified' only after a person has opened its public source page, confirmed it is intended for public viewing and recorded its terms. Entries without that check are 'unverified' leads and carry no stream URL. As of this version no fixed feed has been verified; live coverage comes from the Windy Webcams API when WINDY_WEBCAMS_API_KEY is set.
